bolts-vs-frost.label: Lightning Bolts wand against Frost Bolts wand
bolts-vs-frost.explanation: The Borg carries a Lightning Bolts wand (6d6 beam, about 21 damage) and a Frost Bolts wand (12d8 bolt, about 54 damage). Original: the Lightning Bolts wand is also offered as a Lightning Balls attack worth 64 damage, so the Borg chooses it and would fire a 21-damage beam. Corrected: the Lightning Bolts wand is offered only as a beam and the Borg chooses the Frost Bolts wand.
